description.zh:
过滤器名称。可选择一个或多个名称进行查询。

取值：

- Name：按部署物名称进行模糊查询。

- ArtifactId：部署物ID。

- ArtifactType：部署物类型。
description.en:
The name of the filter. You can specify one or more filter names to query artifacts.

Valid values:

- Name: Performs a fuzzy query by artifact name.

- ArtifactId: The artifact ID.

- ArtifactType: The artifact type.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页行数。其中最大值为100行，默认值为20行。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20.

description.zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值。
description.en: The query token. Set it to the NextToken value returned from the previous API call.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenestsupplier list-artifacts --max-results 20 --next-token AAAAAc3HCuYhJi/wvpk4xOr0VLbfVwapgMwCN1wYzPVzLbItEdB0uWSY7AGnM3qCgm/YnjuEfwSnMwiMkcUoI0hRQzE= --filter '[{"Values":["File"],"Name":"ArtifactType"}]' --resource-group-id rg-acfmzmhzoaa0000 --tag Value=value1 Key=key1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun computenestsupplier ListArtifacts --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key key1 --NextToken 'AAAAAc3HCuYhJi/wvpk4xOr0VLbfVwapgMwCN1wYzPVzLbItEdB0uWSY7AGnM3qCgm/YnjuEfwSnMwiMkcUoI0hRQzE=' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzmhzoaa0000' --MaxResults 20 --Tag.1.Value value1 --Filter.1.Values.1 File --Filter.1.Name ArtifactType
